fact: The ECOWAS 2023 digital report states that Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger rely on coastal countries for submarine cable access, that Burkina Faso pairs with Benin, Cote d'Ivoire, Ghana, Mali and Niger, and that it deployed one virtual landing point.
title: 2023 Digital Report for ECOWAS Countries
publisher: ECOWAS Commission, Digital Economy and Post
